card.name: Last digit of 1980s–1990s years
card.fires_on: The final digit of a four-digit year in the 1980s or 1990s, written as a single digit after 198 or 199. It appears in reference lists and in-text citations.

modes.label: Journal reference dates
modes.description: Year digit ending a date in a journal citation, often before volume or page numbers.
modes.example: , "Reflection Measurements of Microwave Absorbers," Microwave Journal, Vol. 31, No. 12, December 198<<8>>, pp. 95–1

modes.label: Author-year citations
modes.description: Year digit after author names in parentheses or in a bibliography entry.
modes.example: work has a large and established volunteer component. Lange, Frederick W. (editor) 199<<6>> Paths to Central American Prehistory. University
